summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests dose-escalated palliative radiation for painful cancer that has spread to bones outside the spine, or to other non-bone sites. Radiation is given as 50 Gy in 10 fractions, or may be reduced to 40 Gy in 8 fractions for non-spine metastases; at least three daily treatments are given each week, and missed treatments are made up at the end of the schedule. The study measures the complete pain response rate at one month.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa radioterapia paliativa con dosis más altas para el dolor causado por cáncer que se ha extendido a huesos fuera de la columna, o a otros sitios que no son huesos. La radiación se administra como 50 Gy en 10 fracciones, o puede reducirse a 40 Gy en 8 fracciones para metástasis fuera de la columna; se dan al menos tres tratamientos diarios por semana, y los tratamientos perdidos se reponen al final del esquema. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta completa del dolor al mes.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who gave signed informed consent
Bone or non-bone metastases shown by imaging or tissue testing
Life expectancy of six months or more
not_for: Metastases from highly radiosensitive tumors such as lymphoma, myeloma, or germ cell tumor
Active compression of the spinal cord or cauda equina
Previous radiation or SBRT to the same site
More than 3 sites needing radiation treatment
